mission: E15 was a scientific negative on corpus-correlation validation of the capture-envelope thresholds. Design the next discriminating experiment: define what evidence would validate or refute each threshold, gather what is gatherable, and either derive evidence-backed versioned thresholds or prove the corpus is still insufficient with a quantified gap.
headline: Predictive validation of the bands is still impossible (0 labeled units in any boundary bin; downstream reruns need Apple Vision — BLOCKED_EXTERNAL), so no new band values are derivable and v0.3 stands unchanged. The runnable half of the experiment (controlled ffmpeg degradation ladders, ground truth by construction, 288 measurements over the 9 E15 downstream-good units) VALIDATED construct validity for resolution/frame_rate/brightness/motion_blur (9/9 units exact or strictly monotone each) and causally REFUTED it for camera_motion: injected pans of 1-2 px @320w are indistinguishable from subject motion in 8/9 units, and 2/9 zero-camera-motion controls already exceed the supported edge 33.

experimentDesign.criteria: packages/capture-envelope/src/f18ValidationCriteria.ts (f18-envelope-validation-criteria-v1): per dimension, the falsifiable claim, the construct-validity test (proxy tracks the physical quantity; runnable on Linux with ffmpeg-injected degradations whose ground truth is known by construction), and the predictive-validity test (band placement predicts downstream failure; needs Mac pose reruns or labeled clips spanning the boundary), each with explicit validating/refuting outcomes and corpus requirements.
experimentDesign.whyThisDiscriminates: E15 could only correlate verdicts with a corpus whose failures were 51/57 content-driven. F18 separates the two failure modes of a threshold — wrong proxy vs wrong placement — and tests the first causally without any labels, holdout contact, or fresh-candidate use.

datasetScope.sourceUnits: exactly the 9 E15 downstream-good units: 7 corpus scenes from 2 DVIDS recordings (media re-derived from recorded acquisition mediaUrl, SHA-256 verified: afd0b6bad5d0..., d230484fbaa5...) + 1 committed bundle clip (wm-volley-02); 3 independent sessions
datasetScope.heldOutExcluded: wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 never opened, measured, or degraded
datasetScope.freshCandidates: not used (label-blind holdout-candidate pool; f11 not landed on the integration branch)
datasetScope.grouping: every row carries sessionKey (3 independent sessions); no random-frame splits

configuration.harness: packages/capture-envelope/src/f18DegradationLadder.ts (pnpm --filter @pickle/capture-envelope eval:f18); each unit re-encoded once (libx264 crf18) as a shared control so codec effects cancel; ladders: short-side scale {720,640,480,360,240}, fps {24,20,15,12,10,8}, eq brightness {±0.1,±0.2,±0.3}, gblur sigma@320w {0.5,1,2,4}, sinusoidal crop-path pan 1.5 Hz amplitude@320w {0,1,2,4,8,16}

constructValidity.resolution: VALIDATED: measured short side equals the encoded target exactly in 45/45 variant measurements; band status flips exactly at the written 719/479 edges.
constructValidity.frame_rate: VALIDATED: measured avg fps equals the target exactly in 54/54 variant measurements; band flips exactly at 23.x/14.x.
constructValidity.brightness: VALIDATED: mean luma strictly monotone in the injected shift for 9/9 units; edge crossings where arithmetic predicts.
constructValidity.motion_blur: VALIDATED (ordering): Laplacian variance strictly decreasing in sigma for 9/9 units. Caveat: every unit leaves the supported band by sigma@320w=2 and 5/9 by sigma=1 — the supported edge 100 is reachable by very mild blur, so its placement is aggressive and remains unvalidated predictively.
constructValidity.camera_motion: REFUTED: the proxy is monotone in injected pan amplitude for 9/9 units (it does respond to camera motion) but cannot separate camera from subject motion: at 1 and 2 px @320w injected pan, 8/9 units measure below the subject-motion-only control maximum (38.46); at 8 px still 4/9; only 16 px fully separates (min 39.77 > 38.46). 2/9 zero-camera-motion downstream-good controls (35.94, 38.46) already exceed the v0.3 supported edge 33 and are misclassified DEGRADED. The same physical pan (8 px) maps to SUPPORTED on a calm scene (s0: 31.7) and UNSUPPORTED-adjacent on a busy one — the verdict is a property of scene content, not camera stability.
constructValidity.timing_stability: NOT RUN: ffmpeg 4.4.2 offers no decodability-preserving controlled PTS-jitter injection (no setts bsf); refuting/validating needs real VFR captures.
constructValidity.pose_dimensions: BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: player_pixel_height and player_visibility cannot even be measured on Linux (Apple Vision required).

results.measurementFragility: The camera_motion measurement is extraction-path sensitive: the same two scenes measured 32.7/31.9 in E15 (windowed -ss/-t on the original) but 35.9/38.5 after the window is re-encoded and margin-cropped (the zero-pan control path). Bands calibrated at p100 on one path misclassify on the other; any future band derivation must pin the measurement path.
results.thresholdDecision: No band changed. Construct-validated dimensions have no downstream outcomes to re-place their edges against; camera_motion's failure is in the proxy, not the numbers, so re-tuning bands cannot fix it (replace with a background-registered global-motion estimate, e.g. block-matching/phase-correlation against tracked-subject masks). v0.3-provisional stands; refutation recorded in thresholds.ts provenance comment and f18ValidationCriteria.ts.

quantifiedCorpusGap.neededForCalibration: ≥29 downstream-good units for a ≤10% 95% upper bound (≥59 for ≤5%), ideally from ≥10 independent sessions
quantifiedCorpusGap.boundaryBins: 0 labeled units exist in ANY degraded/unsupported bin of any dimension (all labeled-good units: short side ≥720, fps ≥24, luma inside the supported band, Laplacian ≥100, interval CV ≈ 0). Placing each boundary predictively needs ≥10 labeled units per bin, ≥5 sessions per bin: ≈150 labeled clip-scenes concentrated in low-fps (8-23), low-light (luma <60), sub-720p, blurred, and genuinely handheld footage — none of which the usable-rights corpus contains.
quantifiedCorpusGap.cheapestUnblock: One Mac session running pose extraction + mining over the ~270 f18 ladder variants (regenerable via eval:f18) would convert every construct ladder into a predictive dose-response curve without any new footage or labels.

gates.formatCheck: pnpm format:check clean on touched files
gates.tests: pnpm --filter @pickle/capture-envelope test: 29 passed (6 new in test/f18Analysis.test.ts)

limitations: Construct validation says the probes measure what they claim, not that the band edges predict downstream failure — that half remains open and is exactly the quantified gap above.

Degradations are synthetic ffmpeg approximations of real capture pathology (real low light adds sensor noise, real handheld motion includes rolling shutter and parallax); dose-response shapes may differ on real degraded footage.
Camera-motion injection uses a fixed 1.5 Hz sinusoid; other shake spectra were not tested.
9 units / 3 sessions is the entire downstream-good population available; per-unit results are reported, no distributional claims beyond min/max.
